shots.note: HOOK: the 1864 board on the beach with the wrecked Grafton behind it; a slow push-in
the whole island from above its west end: the Grafton camp below, the ridge, the other wreck far away
a tracking shot along the Grafton camp: sawing, hammering, the 5 MEN door, the cooking, the fire
the 40 KM sign, face-on and unobstructed; a slow push-in
the Invercauld men come out of the surf toward us, then turn away from each other
the Grafton crew builds the boat on the beach; a slow arc around the bow
three men sail for help; a follow-cam keeps the boat in frame on the swell
'All five lived': the five together on the beach, cheering
'only three survived': three men standing apart on the dark shore; a slow pull-back
'Same island.': the Grafton five standing on their beach
'Same cold.': the Invercauld three on theirs, the same framing
'Same storms.': the wrecked Grafton in the swell (a bookend of the hook)
PAYOFF: the five around their fire in front of the hut; a slow push-in
